what_happened: Job 20261111-145400-dx3z (code job: "Make usage measures see every role's runs; replay-test against active") ended failed because the producer made no change. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria, no blocker or major findings and no failed checks. Nothing was delivered. The stored fields give no reason for the empty run (already done, blocked, gave up, command denied, or deadline or budget reached).
cause: The producer can end a run with an empty diff and the system records no outcome reason. Nothing makes the producer state whether it found the work already done, was blocked, or gave up, and nothing keeps partial progress. The job therefore fails undiagnosed. The request also bundles a measure change with a replay test against active data, and nothing sizes it to one producer run.
other_causes: The request bundles two parts, a change to the usage measure and a replay test against the active set, and nothing sizes it for one producer run.
No reason is recorded for an empty run, so the failure review can only describe the symptom.
open_hypotheses: The work may already have been done (an earlier job may have made usage measures see every role), so the producer legitimately had nothing to change.
A command denial under the stop-on-denial rule may have ended the run with no change (see class 20261109-090811-e15f).
The producer may have hit its deadline or budget cap before editing anything.
The scope may have been too large for one run (compare 20261025-185414-aapc).
contradictions: The earlier cases in the same class family (20261109-075105-011b) were multi-surface jobs, but this event gives no list of criteria or files, so a size cause is not confirmed.
prevention: Require the producer to end every run with a structured outcome: changed, already done (with evidence), blocked (with the blocker), or gave up (with the reason). Have Athena also record policy denials and deadline or budget stops for the run. Fail an empty diff as a diagnosed hold, not as a bare failure. Check that the producer's report maps to each acceptance criterion. With that outcome record, the failure review could state the reason for every empty run.
proposed_request:
Make the usage measure count runs of every role, including roles that run outside job records, and check it against the active set. Do this in one change.

Acceptance:
- A test shows the usage measure counts a role whose runs appear only outside job invocation records, and that role is no longer flagged as unused.
- A replay of the measure against the active roles lists, for each role, its count and the data source it came from. Roles known to be in use are not flagged as unused.
- If you make no change, your report must say why: already done (with the evidence), blocked (by what), or gave up (why).
- fmt, clippy and test pass.
- CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the change.
